name: ClawGuard Auto
description: Automatically scans selected tool inputs with the managed ClawGuard skill before tool execution.

scannerPath.description: Path to the managed ClawGuard scanner wrapper.

scanTools.description: Tool names that should be scanned before execution.

blockOnSanitize.description: Block tool execution when ClawGuard returns sanitize.

maxUrlBytes.description: Maximum response size to download when scanning URL inputs.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout for ClawGuard subprocesses and URL scans.
